README.md

cloud-me-pub-profiles-prf-prs

🐧 Unix 1 › 🙋 Cloud-Me 1.2 › Pub 1.2.1 › Profiles 1.2.1.1

Professional and personal profiles (split from Me-Profiles)

CodeVisibilityHubDeveloperFarm folder
1.2.1.1.4🌐 publiccloud-me-pub-profiles-___ 1.2.1.1.0Leaf.y1.2.Cloud-me/Pub/Profiles/

Professional and personal profile sites: the b_Profiles group (myprofile, mySocials, cv_pdf, cv_web, landpage; mySocials moved in from front-media and the three CV and landing projects from front-individual, #1196) and c_Circus/myAstro (moved from CG-circus, #1218). Split on 2026-10-28 out of cloud-me-pub-profiles (formerly cloud-me-profiles), which is now the hub of the cloud-me-pub-profiles family.

Paths mirror the original layout (b_Profiles/..., c_Circus/myAstro at the repo root); published URLs are unchanged. The Pages workflow of diegonmarcos.github.io checks this repo out over its workspace and publishes it. SPLIT-PATHS.txt lists the overlaid paths.

Repository

Member of the cloud-me-pub-profiles hub (public cloud-me family). Wiring follows the deployer conventions: .github and 1_cicd symlinks into the 0_deployer submodule (diegonmarcos.github.io, shallow, ignore = all).
